newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares drift to highs in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares drift to highs in calm trade.

text.p: Swedish share prices rose on Thursday, boosted by gains in telecoms group Ericsson and overnight advances on Wall Street.
At 0950 the stock exchange's general index had risen 0.36 percent to 3,021.07, new record territory, in quiet turnover totalling 1.2 billion crowns.
The U.S. Independence Day holiday would continue to dampen trade, brokers said. Market focus was on U.S. June jobs data.
Drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn's warning that second quarter profits would not match those of the first quarter, or 37 U.S. cents per share, did not phase the market.
After initial weakening the share traded 1.5 crowns higher at 278.
Analysts said news of the company's plans to restructure could overshadow the second quarter profit warning, which had been already discounted by the market for the most part.

Telecoms group Ericsson traded 4.5 crowns higher at 310, helped by news of its $106 million deal with Chilean long-distance provider Entel Chile SA and another major GSM expansion contract in China worth $110 million.
